notes: Two taḥwīl branches («ح» before «وحدثنا ابن نمير») meet at عبيد الله; the names after them (خبيب, حفص, أبو هريرة) are written once and belong to both
«حدثنا أبي» gives the father of ابن نمير by relation only (rule 7)
The Prophet is not written; «أبي هريرة» is the Companion whose words are the saying
